To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
NRG1-II-ErbB signaling promotes cell divisions generating neurons in the developing zebrafish brain.
NRG1-II–ErbB signal promotes cell divisions generating neurons in the developing vertebrates.
NRG1-II-ErbB signaling promotes mitoses of neural precursor cells in the sub- and basal ventricular zone to produce post-mitotic neuroblasts in the developing zebrafish brain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of NRG/ErbB signaling in the production of neurons from neural progenitors in the developing zebrafish brain.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the generation of post-mitosis neurons from neural progenitors.
the mechanisms of brain formation and the role of NRG-ErbB signaling in the developing brain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Neuregulin-1 (NRG1) is required for mitoses in the SVZ of the developing zebrafish brain, and that NRG1 is required for mitosis in the SVZ.
NRG1-II is a cell-extrinsic signaling molecule that regulates cell divisions in the developing vertebral brain.

Neuregulin-1 type II (Nrg1-II) signaling is required for mitotic divisions of progenitor cells generating neurons in the sub- ventricular zone of the zebrafish optic tectum and that the Nrg1-II signaling promotes cell divisions generating neurons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the balance between NRG1-Erbb signaling and Notch signaling is important for the generation of neurons and glia from radial glial progenitors.
the NRG1-ErhB signaling is required for mitoses in the basal-to-ventricular zone for production of neurons from neural progenitors in the developing vertebrates.
cell divisions generating neurons are promoted in a cell-extrinsic manner by NRG1-ErB signaling.
The main takeaway from our work is that

NRG1 type II-ErbB signaling is a cell-extrinsic or cell-to-cell signaling mechanism that regulates mitoses of neural precursor cells for generation of neurons in the sub- and ventricular zones of the developing zebrafish brain.
the NRG1-ErB signaling is essential for cell divisions generating neurons in the developing vertebrates.
NRG1 signaling promotes mitosis in the sub- and sub-basal ventricular zones to generate neurons.
